summary: Tuya Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a board meeting announcement and press release regarding its upcoming first quarter 2026 unaudited financial results. The board will meet on May 11, 2026, to approve the quarterly results, and management will hold an earnings conference call on May 12, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. Hong Kong Time. No transaction, special situation, or strategic corporate action is disclosed. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings announcement and notification of a board meeting, with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situation event. All exhibits relate to share buyback disclosures or board meeting logistics, not a fundamental change in the company's structure or control.
